description: Generate a clean PDF from Markdown (or raw HTML) on-device, rendered through a real browser engine so it looks printed — not like a script's best guess. Give it Markdown inline via `source` (or a file via `sourcePath`) and an `outputPath`; it writes the PDF and returns the path. Use this instead of writing a one-off reportlab/LaTeX/pandoc script. Nothing is uploaded.

css.description: extra CSS appended after the default print styles

outputPath.description: absolute path to write the PDF

sourcePath.description: absolute path to a Markdown/HTML file

name: create_pdf
